subject.title: Embedded runner: freshly streamed thinking signatures intermittently invalid on replay (Anthropic); recovery wrapper never fires because error text is genericized

question: Should this umbrella stay open until all Anthropic signed-thinking replay variants are resolved, or should maintainers make https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 the canonical remaining prevention issue now that #92916 and #95430 landed?
rationale: The recovery-carrier fixes are on main, but the remaining prevention path changes Anthropic thinking replay semantics and has multiple open candidate PRs with non-trivial compatibility risk.

options.title: Keep Umbrella Open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

options.title: Make Narrow Issue Canonical
options.body: Close this issue as superseded by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/99382 after posting a clear handoff to the narrowed prevention PRs.

options.title: Backport Recovery Only
options.body: Treat #92916 and #95430 as the only release-critical fixes and defer prevention policy to a later provider replay review.

recommendation.title: Keep Umbrella Open
recommendation.body: Leave this issue open as the broad incident tracker until the chosen prevention PR lands or maintainers formally split the remaining variants.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is already in the issue discussion around the landed recovery half and appears in current area history for the affected files, making him the best available routing candidate from this review.
